text:
Type: white beaded picture frame with mat
Use: displaying a photo or print on a wall, a shelf or a desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: painted molded frame with a beaded inner trim, white paper mat, clear front panel
Colors: white, off-white mat
Shape: rectangular frame with a wide stepped profile and a row of small beads around the opening, deep mat border, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, bright, romantic, timeless
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, brass accents; classic, French country or farmhouse rooms

product.name: SNDRUM
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
